turns: can i have some water?
yes. here is your cup.
i am hungry. what can i eat?
you can have an apple and some bread.
is the soup hot?
yes. wait for it to cool before you eat.
i do not like this milk.
would you like juice instead?
where is my red ball?
it is under the bed.
can we play with the blocks?
yes. let us build a big house.
that is my toy. give it back!
sorry. here you go. can i have a turn next?
my little car has a broken wheel.
let us try to fix it together.
where did mom go?
she went to the shop. dad is here with you.
who is that baby?
that is your sister. she is asleep.
can grandma come to our house?
yes. she will come after lunch.
why is my brother crying?
he misses grandpa. give him a hug.
why are you sad?
i lost my bear. can you help me find it?
i am scared of the dark.
i am here. we can turn on the light.
are you happy now?
yes. i found my bear in the box.
i feel angry when you take my things.
i understand. i will ask first next time.
i am not tired. can i stay up?
it is time for bed. we can read one book.
where is my blanket?
it is on your bed beside the pillow.
will you sing to me?
yes. then close your eyes and go to sleep.
i had a bad dream last night.
you are safe now. do you want a cuddle?
can we go outside?
yes. put on your shoes and coat.
why is the ground wet?
because it rained. look at that puddle.
look! a bird is in the tree.
i see it. the bird has a small nest.
the wind blew my hat away.
it landed near the fence. we can get it.
my hand hurts.
show me where. did you fall?
do i need to wash my hands?
yes. use soap and water before dinner.
i need to go to the toilet.
okay. i will help you.
my tummy feels funny.
sit down and tell me more.
do you want the red cup or the blue cup?
the blue one, please.
which is bigger, the dog or the cat?
the dog is bigger. the cat is smaller.
how many apples are there?
there are two apples. one for you and one for me.
these socks are different. which pair matches?
the two yellow socks match.
give me that, please.
which one do you mean?
you want the green ball?
no. i said the red ball, not the green one.
i do not know what that means.
let me show you again.
i cannot hear you. say it slowly.
please bring the empty bowl here.
i put the bear in the box and the ball on the bed. where is the bear?
the bear is in the box.
mom has a red hat. dad has a blue hat. who has the blue hat?
dad has the blue hat.
we ate lunch and then went to the park. what did we do first?
we ate lunch first.
the cat was on the chair. now it is behind the door. where is it now?
it is behind the door.
hello. what is your name?
my name is sam. what is your name?
thank you for helping me.
you are welcome. i like helping you.
i have to go home now.
goodbye. see you tomorrow!
may i sit next to you?
of course. there is room for both of us.
tell me a story about a dog.
a little dog was hungry. he found some food. then he went home.
what happened to the small cat?
she ran up a tree. she could not get down. her friend helped her.
why did the bear share his apple?
his friend was hungry too. they ate together and felt happy.
tell me about a rabbit and a duck.
the rabbit dropped a carrot into the pond. the duck swam over and brought it back.
